## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The compatibility transition should be fixed because existing `--wait` invocations fail despite the documented one-release alias.

## Changes
The pull request renames the parser option to `--timeout`, updates its tests, and adds a transition decision. It preserves the default of 30 and the JSON/CSV format choices.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Restore the deprecated --wait alias — For `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])`, the parser now exits with an unrecognized-argument error. Registering only `--timeout` removes the compatibility behavior documented in `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5`: “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts using `--wait` stop working immediately, preventing users from completing the documented migration period. — Fix: Accept both spellings, warn when `--wait` is used, and extend `test_explicit_options` to cover the alias.
